name: Uncle Sato
source:
Uncle Sato simply goes by "Sato" to everyone, except for his very cheerful nephew, Taru. Sato is a pilot by trade and is currently Taru's guardian. He has a very strong connection with his nephew, and knows most of his past very well. Like his nephew, he's a very upbeat person normally, but unlike him, does have more concerns in his life- but generally ignores them.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=25920]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
